title: CSV rerun fail-closed validation and status
summary: Fixed CSV rerun preview/start/preflight semantics for duplicate rows, relative paths, missing sources, invalid media extensions, manifest operator status, and terminal WebView activity evidence.
reason: CSV rerun controls queue launch scope and source discovery. Preview, preflight, start, and PowerShell planning needed one fail-closed row classifier so invalid CSV rows cannot silently launch or fall back to full-library/source-discovery behavior.
behavior_before: Duplicate source_path rows were warning-only in preview and could reach start as a partial launch. Relative, nonexistent, and invalid-extension source_path rows were inconsistently treated as backend blockers. Preview did not correlate CSV rows with completed, pending-publish, or prior rerun evidence. Documentation still listed removed WebView confirmation checkbox IDs.
behavior_after: Duplicate source_path, relative source_path, missing source file, invalid extension, and unsafe lifecycle rows are blocked in preview/start unless the operator explicitly scopes them out with skip_blocked. Rerun launch preflight mirrors the preview classifier read-only. PowerShell planning rejects relative, missing, and invalid-extension rows before staging. Queue/Home rerun manifest rows project status and reason into operator-visible severity. WebView CSV rerun terminal stdout no longer keeps tail-only activity active.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-RerunPlanOnlyChecks.ps1: relative, missing, invalid-extension, empty, and malformed CSV rows fail PlanOnly without staging or manifest writes
tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_process_launch.py: rerun start/preflight block invalid CSV source rows before spawn and remain read-only
tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_queue.py: CSV rerun manifest status/reason drives operator status and severity
tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static.py: terminal CSV rerun stdout does not keep tail-only activity active
tests/python/desktop/test_rerun_csv_preview.py: CSV structure errors, duplicate blocking, path/existence/extension blockers, and scoped valid rows
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --changed -> passed, 4 written, 28 unchanged
rollback_plan: Revert the CSV rerun preview/state-correlation files, Invoke-RerunCsv.ps1 relative-source resolver change, targeted tests, inventory/contract documentation updates, regenerated summaries for these files, and this change packet. No source media, scratch staging, or queue state is written by rollback.
